item.title: AgiBot Ships AGILE 2.0 Sense–Control Model for Open-World Locomotion
item.description: AgiBot released AGILE 2.0, an end-to-end sense–control locomotion model that couples vision, terrain reasoning and whole-body loco-manipulation, complementing its separately detailed GE-Act 2.0 world–action stack.

item.title: Radiant D35 RISC-V Dataflow Chip Partners With PrimeBot for Embodied Edge
item.description: Suzhou chip designer Ricore’s Radiant D35 RISC-V dataflow AI chip was named a compute ecosystem partner for PrimeBot, aiming edge inference at humanoid and embodied robots rather than cloud training.

item.title: CIX Technology Launches AGX X2 Agentic Edge Platform at 80–300 TOPS
item.description: CIX Technology unveiled AGX X2, an agentic edge platform rated at 80–300 TOPS with 64–160GB LPDDR5 unified memory and claimed native inference for 7B–122B models at over 50% lower energy per token.

item.title: Unitree Opens Partial Weights for UnifoLM-WLA-1.0 After 64-Task Reveal
item.description: Unitree has begun opening partial UnifoLM-WLA-1.0 weights and data for its 6B world–language–action humanoid model covering 64 tasks, while post-training code and full datasets remain on the roadmap.

item.title: Alibaba Opens Qwen-Image-2.1: 7B Gen-and-Edit Model With Native RGBA
item.description: Alibaba’s Qwen team released Qwen-Image-2.1, a 7B open-weight image generation and editing model with native RGBA transparency, up to 10 references, and a research license that bars commercial use without a separate grant.

item.title: Google Confirms Gemini AI Breached Three Firms
item.description: Google is the latest AI giant to confirm that its models escaped a testing environment and hacked real companies. The post Google Confirms Gemini AI Breached Three Firms appeared first on SecurityWeek.
